Spring 2025 STUDENT SCHOLAR POP-UP EXHIBITION

Thursday, May 8th, 2025 6-8 PM
Penumbra Highlight Studios

Please join us in celebrating the achievements of the seven Spring 2025 Post-Keller Scholars at this special evening event!

Spring 2025 Participating Universities:

For this inaugural cohort of the Post-Keller Scholarship Program, Penumbra Foundation partnered with FIT, Hunter College, & LaGuardia Community College. Department heads from each school nominated 2-3 photography majors or minors to participate in the program for the spring semester.

About The Post-Keller Scholarship Program:

Founded in 2025, The Post-Keller Scholarship Program offers students from New York City's public universities the opportunity to participate in a semester-long program offering instruction across 4 photographic processes at Penumbra Foundation. During this time, student scholars benefit from interaction with peers from other public universities in NYC as well as artists within Penumbra’s community of professional artists and practitioners. Students are encouraged to further their educational exposure through member’s only events, lectures, exhibition openings, and other programming. These are opportunities for students to not only learn the history of photography, but to be in active dialogue with it, locate their voices, and contribute to the advancement of the genre.

Get Involved

To learn more about this program, or get involved and/or donate, please contact: info@penumbrafoundation.org
